value.rationale: The map is originally posed on unbounded complete supporting lines, so global approach time and orientation-basin arclength are natural structural observables. The theorem gives the full equilateral recurrent set and an unexpected absence of one-sided basin density despite universal periodic attraction, with sharp oscillation 1/3–2/3 and an exact geometric first-entry law. This is not an arbitrary finite test or a restatement of the two-cycle existence count.
